title: A/P: a bill payment made after a past as-of date is not taken off
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Vendor Y has a $200.00 bill dated day D.
  • $80.00 of it was paid on day D + 4 (a past day).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/P Aging Detail" in the left list.
  3. Set the date chip to day D + 1.
  4. Open every bucket.
  5. Read the bill's Open Balance.
  6. Set the date chip to day D + 4.
  7. Open every bucket.
  8. Read the bill's Open Balance.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 5:

  • Open Balance $200.00.

Step 8:

  • Open Balance $120.00.

Why this matters: A past month-end payables report must show what was owed then.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Doctrine/AccountPayable/Service/DbalApAgingSummaryFetcher.php:86-105; api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Doctrine/AccountPayable/Service/DbalApAgingDetailFetcher.php:133-169. V1 code, quoted: `vps.payment_date <= :asOfDate ... (vt.amount - COALESCE(p.paid_amount, 0)) AS openBalance`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-027) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v12 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
